settings.title: Electrolux AEG
settings.subtitle: Connect Homey to your appliances using the official Electrolux Group developer API
settings.step_1: Sign in at developer.electrolux.one with the same account you use in the Electrolux or AEG mobile app.
settings.step_2: On the Dashboard, create an API key.
settings.step_3: Click GET ACCESS TOKEN to generate an access token and refresh token.
settings.step_4: Paste all three values below and save. Use a token pair only for Homey - don't share it with other apps, as Homey renews the tokens automatically.
settings.token_placeholder_keep: Leave blank to keep the current token
settings.polling_note: The free Electrolux developer plan allows 5000 API calls per day. With many appliances the interval is increased automatically to stay within this limit.
settings.status_not_configured: Not configured - enter your API key, access token and refresh token
settings.status_auth_failed: Credentials rejected - generate a new access token and refresh token and enter them again
settings.status_rate_limited: Electrolux API rate limit reached - updates resume automatically
settings.status_error: Connection problem - retrying on next poll
settings.error_missing_fields: Please enter the API key, access token and refresh token.
settings.error_invalid_credentials: The API key, access token or refresh token was rejected by Electrolux.
settings.error_connect: Could not connect to the Electrolux API

auth.unavailable: Electrolux credentials rejected. Enter a new access token and refresh token in the app settings.
auth.notification: Electrolux AEG: your developer credentials were rejected or have expired. Open the app settings and enter a new access token and refresh token from developer.electrolux.one.
auth.migration: Electrolux AEG 2.0 uses the official Electrolux Group developer API. Email and password login is no longer supported - open the app settings and enter an API key, access token and refresh token from developer.electrolux.one.

errors.fan_speed_smart_mode: Fan speed cannot be changed while the purifier is in Smart mode
